data.gender_notes: Orazio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'orare', meaning to ask or pray, Orazio is a name of courage and perseverance. It is believed to have originated from the early Christian martyrs, who were known for their unwavering faith and courage in the face of persecution. The name Orazio carries the meaning “Man's courage” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Orazio usually hope their child will grow to embody man's courage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of inner strength and courage.
data.etymology: Orazio belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man's courage.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Orazio total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
